contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Victory left issue of 364-378, Reece period 19, Arles mint. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALE[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: reads VIC IAE CCC ?blundered [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: PCON. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 0.74gms, die…
